mapper.sql: q.id AS contentId, q.title, q.content, q.author, q.source, q.dynasty, q.poetry_category AS poetryCategory, q.author_id AS authorId, q.created_time AS createdTime, COALESCE(fs.hot_score, 0) AS hotScore, COALESCE(fs.quality_score, 0) AS qualityScore, COALESCE(fs.freshness_score, 0) AS freshnessScore, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM quote_tag qt JOIN tag t ON qt.tag_id = t.id WHERE qt.quote_id = q.id ) AS tagNames, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT qt2.topic_id ORDER BY qt2.topic_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM quote_topic qt2 WHERE qt2.quote_id = q.id AND qt2.deleted = 0 AND qt2.status = 1 ) AS topicIds
FROM quote q LEFT JOIN content_feature_snapshot fs ON fs.content_id = q.id WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1
